summary: Project member on a student research team taking an AI project from ideation to a final research paper and presentation at CUCAI 2027.

summary: AI engineering internship in Ankara, Türkiye, under the Artificial Intelligence Technologies Group Directorate.
highlights: Built a custom probabilistic transformer model that predicts the future displacement of ships, a learnable alternative to Interacting Multiple Model (IMM) filters.
Implemented an encoder-decoder backbone followed by a mixture density network that learns the Gaussian distribution of K different motion banks, optimized with a negative log loss (NLL).
The resulting model performed equal to the IMM benchmark and the classical transformer benchmark on 10% of the dataset, with tanh gradient saturation estimated under 1%.
Co-built a data-generation pipeline using Monte-Carlo and Latin Hypercube sampling methods, with a FastAPI backend service and Docker deployment hosting the pipeline for different model repositories.
Built the team's web interface for the pipeline in React 19 and TypeScript, covering scenario configuration, simulation runs, dataset browsing, and model-vs-baseline rankings per prediction horizon.

summary: Intern at the Cyberpark office @ Bilkent in Ankara, Türkiye, working under the Flight Software Testing Unit.
highlights: Built real-time telemetry monitoring software in Python and PyQt6 for decoding and visualizing binary packet streams from embedded hardware over TCP/UDP.
Shipped a user-defined packet schema editor, a live KPI dashboard with auto-expanding tiles, per-channel plotting, and a full CRC integrity pipeline supporting preset and custom algorithms.
Designed around a clean singleton service architecture with subservices for packet ingestion and connection management.
Achieved thread-safe packet ingestion at 4000+ packets/sec with >1000 bytes per packet.
